notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.1.0
notes.content:
Patch Notes 0.1.1.0
Content

Added Level 3 God cards with a very low probability of appearing.
Added challenges to increase the difficulty of your run.

Balance

Healing potions now restore full health.
Enemies progressively become stronger as the game advances, both in terms of the number and the quality of cards they use, ensuring a smoother game experience.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a crash issue when selecting a deck.
